 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE YASHWANT VARMA  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAVINDER DUDEJA  ORDER % 12.12.2023 1.
This batch of writ petitions had come to be placed before us pursuant to the judgment dated 17 January 2023 passed by the Supreme Court on a batch of Special Leave Petitions.
On a preliminary examination of the writ petitions, we find that the petitioners assail the acquisition proceedings initiated under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 ["1894 Act"] on merits.
However, some of them have restricted their prayers to the release of compensation along with statutory benefits.

2. We are also cognizant of the fact that the order of the Supreme Court while remanding the matter has left it open to the petitioners to assail the acquisition proceedings including on the ground of there being no material justifying the invocation of the emergency powers This is a digitally signed order.

3. We also take note of the submission of some of the learned counsels who contended that the estimated compensation has also not been paid.

4. Today, Mr. Mahapatra and Mr. Pathak, learned counsels representing the Land Acquisition Collector ["LAC"] have sought time to file a comprehensive affidavit dealing with all contentions which are raised by the writ petitioners.
Let the said affidavit be filed within a period of three weeks from today.
